quote:
You carry heavy weight in silence every single day.
You wear a smile so nobody sees your pain.
You bleed inside while fixing everyone else's broken pieces.
You forget your own soul while saving all the rest.
You wonder if anyone would notice if you finally fell.
True strength is just surviving until the morning light breaks through.
